physical_explanation: All 12 physical stills exhibit an identical isotropic point-spread function with a 4-5 pixel edge transition width (MTF50 ~ 11-12 cycles/deg vs theoretical sampling density of 51.69 px/deg). Because camera rotational velocity was negligible (0.35 deg/s) and sharpness is globally uniform across center and edges (C/E ratio ~ 1.02), motion blur and optical field curvature are ruled out. The sharpness limit is governed by the Samsung S23 Ultra f/1.7 main camera autofocus operating in continuous search mode (focusMode: continuous) without a shutter focus-settle gate, combined with heavy multi-frame computational denoise smearing on flat textures.
